0022600006.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Philadelphia 76ers, who have not yet played a game this season. Cleveland is missing Nae'Qwan Tomlin (out, back), while Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (out, back) and Tacko Fall (out, hip), and the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 win in Cleveland on March 9, 2026.
